definition: Computes one or more named radiometric indices (e.g. NDVI, NDWI, SAVI) from the relevant spectral channels of the input raster(s).

hasAction.description: The Relations text of this activity type now names the two Implementation Profiles that point to it with activityType, radiometric-index and radiometric-index-single-band (added 2026-11-10), instead of one. The definition, parent class and entity types are unchanged. Classified clarifying, a documentary text.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/radiometric-index to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/radiometric-index, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/radiometric-index/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

The parent class (rdfs:subClassOf) changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/geoprocessing/GeoprocessingActivityType to the family https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/band-algebra, itself a sub-class of it (decision of 2026-11-19: activity types grouped by meaning). The definition and the entity types are unchanged. Classified substantive, a change of parent class.
